Name: LabelJoints
Description: Find all joints in the scene and label them.

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Labels every joint in the scene using smart side/name parsing.

How To Use:
  Create this block and run Build.

Behavior:
- Processes all joints in scene (selection is ignored).
- Sets joint side as Left/Right/Center.
- Sets type to Other and writes clean label text into otherType.

Naming Support:
- Prefix side: L_*, R_*, Left*, Right*.
- Suffix side: *_l, *_r, *_L, *_R (Unreal style).
- Strips common tail tokens like Bnd, Skl, Jnt, Bind, Guide, JntCtrl.
